stats.notes: From the Common Data Set 2024-25 (fall 2024 entering class): 4,094 applied, 1,205 admitted, 380 enrolled; the residency rows (in-state / out-of-state / international) add up to the totals. International (nonresident) first-years: 1,275 applied, 119 admitted, 45 enrolled. The ED figure covers both Early Decision plans (the CDS gives no split). Bryn Mawr did not report an average high-school GPA or a GPA breakdown (C11/C12 are blank). Bryn Mawr's 2025-26 CDS is posted, but its answers are drawn as outlines and cannot be read as text, so 2024-25 is the newest readable CDS. The college's 2025-26 Quick Facts report fall 2025: 4,260 applied, 1,199 admitted, 329 matriculated. Undergraduate enrollment (1,363) is the CDS B1 total of degree-seeking undergraduates (1,352 full-time + 11 part-time); the international count (178) is the B2 nonresident degree-seeking undergraduates. SAT/ACT percentiles are for enrolled students; submission is optional. The admission-factor grid (C7) comes from the 2023-24 CDS: the 2024-25 PDF leaves the rigor row unmarked and shows class rank as Very Important (2023-24: Important), and its other 16 rows match the 2023-24 answers.

cost.notes: Published 2026-27 sticker price from Bryn Mawr's Tuition, Fees, and Costs page: tuition $71,290; food and housing $21,440 (room only $12,240); College Fee $1,120 (shown as required fees); Student Government Association dues $441 and a Continuing Enrollment Fee of $590 per semester are also billed; books and supplies $1,000; miscellaneous $1,000; loan fees $76; travel varies. The page prints a total estimated cost of attendance of $97,547.
